title: Flat constant extension and K-flat tensor of pro-zero cone towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $R=\underline A$ its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $R\to\mathcal O$ a flat map of commutative ring sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For an $A$-complex $X$, put $E(X)=\mathcal O\otimes_R\underline X$, termwise. Let $v_n:X_n\to Y_n$ be a strict map of inverse sequences of $A$-complexes, whose cone tower is pro-zero in $D(A)$: for every $n$, some transition $\operatorname{Cone}(v_m)\to\operatorname{Cone}(v_n)$, $m\geq n$, is zero. Use derived categories and mapping cones [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], sheaf tensor and total tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For every possibly unbounded K-flat $\mathcal O$-complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], the strict map
$$P\otimes_{\mathcal O}E(X_\bullet)\longrightarrow P\otimes_{\mathcal O}E(Y_\bullet)$$
has a pro-zero cone tower in $D(\mathcal O)$ and induces an isomorphism on total right derived inverse limits of strict towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. If compatible chain maps $A[0]\to X_n,Y_n$ make $v_n$ commute with their units, that isomorphism carries the induced map $P\to R\lim(P\otimes E(X_n))$ to $P\to R\lim(P\otimes E(Y_n))$. These maps are the strict cones followed by the K-injective derived-limit comparison, not independently chosen maps in a triangulated category.
